Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Reminder:

Heroes and Dragons (Columbia, SC) will host a Bloodlines Pre-Release
party this Saturday. Registration from 11-11:30.

We're using the 40/40 format described by other groups:

Each player brings a deck with a 40-card library and an 8-card
crypt. The vampires in the crypt should have capacities summing to 40
(and average of 5 per vampire) or more. These are refered to as
"40/40 decks".

Each player can bring any number of such decks (and then choose
one to play later, after the draft, see below).

Each player will then purchase 4 bloodlines boosters (at standard
retail) which will be drafted per the standard V:EKN Booster Draft
procedures.

From the drafted cards, each player will add 20 library cards (or more)
and 4 crypt cards (or more) to his or her chosen 40/40 deck.
